body:
*** day 1 ***
I took one flower only and let it dry for a day, then cut it into small pieces, put into tea mug and poured hot water on it. I let it sit for 30 minutes and then drunk half of it.
+00:30 I dont feel anything.
+01:00 I still dont feel anything and drink the rest of the tea left.
+02:00 I feel little bit anxious and tired.
+02:30 My head is spinning, but not so much and I get scared for no reason.
+03:20 I feel like I had 2 beers and a bit nauseous. Its not very fun, because I kinda feel like someones after me and every shadow seems scary.
+04:10 I feel still the same, but now very tired so I go to sleep.
*** day 2 ***
+15:30 Just woke up and I feel tired, but nothing else.
It was not a real trip and I felt more scared and tired than high. Maybe I just didnt make strong enough tea. I also think that the trip would of been a lot scarier if I had drunk more of this.
I probably will not try this again, too risky and scary trip, even when quantities are small.
